- [IDAT.1.6] **Per-engine state, no globals.** Every struct
  instance an engine owns belongs to exactly one
  `ds_engine_t`; a `ds_json_t` tree belongs to none
  ([IARC.1.11]). The integrator **must not** pass an engine a
  handle another engine handed out, a fact or a schema, nor a
  fact handle whose fact is not live ([IDAT.3.1]). Either is
  undefined behaviour: libds owes no check for it, and a caller
  **must not** take any status as reporting it. A schema is a handle like any other here,
  whether or not this engine holds a schema of the same name.
